# Narvar | Intelligent Personalization Beyond Buy

> Narvar delivers personalized, data-driven experiences from returns management to package tracking and fraud prevention that engage consumers, optimize operations, and unlock sustainable growth.

## Post-Purchase Experience Enhancements
- [Promise AI-powered delivery date estimates to boost conversion](https://corp.narvar.com/promise): Narvar provides AI-driven delivery date estimates that enhance customer expectations and improve conversion rates.
- [Track Personalized tracking experiences to build brand loyalty](https://corp.narvar.com/track): Customized tracking experiences are designed to foster brand loyalty by keeping customers informed throughout the delivery process.
- [Notify Proactive communication to drive customer lifetime value](https://corp.narvar.com/notify): Proactive notifications are utilized to enhance customer engagement and increase lifetime value.
- [Assist Delivery claim management to tackle fraud and build trust](https://corp.narvar.com/assist): Narvar's solutions help manage delivery claims effectively, reducing fraud and enhancing customer trust.
- [Shield Returns and exchanges management to mitigate fraud and reward best customers](https://corp.narvar.com/return-exchange): The platform offers robust returns and exchanges management to minimize fraud while rewarding loyal customers.
- [Secure Seamless shipping insurance that resolves issues fast and protects shopper confidence](https://corp.narvar.com/secure): Fully integrated shipping insurance solution that helps retailers offer peace of mind to consumers at checkout—while protecting margin and unlocking new revenue.


## Narvar's Solutions by Value
- [Agentic AI for Post Purchase Retail Automation](https://corp.narvar.com/agentic-ai-post-purchase): Discover how Agentic AI transforms post-purchase from a cost center to a control system. Automate delivery resolutions, adaptive returns, and proactive loyalty.
- [Protect Revenue Reduce payouts by 25% with IRIS-powered fraud and abuse detection](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/protect-revenue): Narvar's IRIS technology helps reduce financial losses by detecting fraud and abuse effectively.
- [Retain Revenue Increase repurchases by 60% with exchanges or store credit](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/retain-revenue): The system encourages repeat purchases through effective management of exchanges and store credit.
- [Grow Revenue Boost ROI by 15x with product recommendations and cross sell opportunities](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/grow-revenue): Narvar enhances revenue growth through targeted product recommendations and cross-selling strategies.

## Narvar's Solutions by Function
- [Ecommerce & Digital](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/ecommerce-digital): Tailored solutions for online retail environments.
- [Customer Care](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/customer-care): Tools and strategies to enhance customer support and satisfaction.
- [Supply Chain & Logistics](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/supply-chain): Solutions designed to optimize supply chain operations.
- [Risk & Fraud](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/fraud-risk): Comprehensive strategies to manage and mitigate risks associated with fraud.

##Narvar's Solutions by Journey Stage
- [Pre-Purchase](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/pre-purchase): Insights and tools to enhance the customer experience before the purchase is made.
- [Delivery](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/delivery): Solutions that ensure a smooth delivery process, enhancing customer satisfaction.
- [Post-Delivery](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/post-delivery): Strategies and tools to engage customers after the purchase, ensuring continued loyalty.


## Operational Efficiency
- [Increase Operational Efficiency Save up to 89% in return logistics costs](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/increase-operational-efficiency): Narvar's solutions streamline return logistics, significantly reducing operational costs.

## Partner Integrations
- [Partner Network Deliver engaging order tracking experiences](https://corp.narvar.com/partners): Narvar collaborates with various partners to deliver enhanced order tracking experiences.

## Supported Platforms
- [Shopify](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/shopify)
- [Zendesk](https://www.zendesk.com/marketplace/apps/support/204089/narvar-connect-and-care/)
- [BigCommerce](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/bigcommerce-returns-tracking-integration)
- [Klaviyo](https://integrations.klaviyo.com/narvar)
- [Magento](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/magento-tracking-returns-management)
- [Gorgias](https://www.gorgias.com/apps/narvar)
- [Salesforce](https://corp.narvar.com/solutions/salesforce-commerce-cloud)
- [Attentive](https://help.attentivemobile.com/hc/en-us/articles/34556159879188-Narvar#h_01JKBJ5F6588GSXJERAK8CYWYB)

## Industry Applications
- [Apparel & Accessories](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Apparel+%26+Accessories)
- [Footwear](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Footwear)
- [Beauty & Skincare](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Beauty+%26+Skincare)
- [Healthcare](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Healthcare)
- [Electronics & Gaming](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Electronics+%26+Gaming)
- [Home & Pets](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Home+%26+Pets)
- [Food & Beverage](https://corp.narvar.com/customers?vertical=Food+%26+Beverage)

## Customer Success Stories
- [See All Customer Stories](https://corp.narvar.com/customers)
- [How Seager retains $0.43 on every $1 of returns](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/seagerco)
- [WISMR 37% down for UK fashion brand Seasalt Cornwall](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/seasalt-cornwall)
- [Sugarfina reduces support calls while delivering a sweet experience](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/sugarfina)
- [How Orvis recovered $185k in returns revenue and cut WISMR by 42%](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/orvis)
- [Sonos and the sound of higher conversion rates](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/sonos)
- [Cutting WISMO + WISMR by 50% in 3 weeks](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/crystal-classics)
- [Jo Loves Reduces WISMO Queries By Nearly 95% With Narvar](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/jo-loves)
- [Swiss sports brand On races to revenue with AI-driven post-purchase experiences](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/on-running)
- [Why Wolf & Shepherd automated tracking and returns](https://corp.narvar.com/customer-stories/wolf-and-shepherd)

<script>
  (() => {
    const UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    const STORAGE_DAYS = 90;

    const getStorage = (key) => {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if ((Date.now() - parsed.t) / 86400000 > STORAGE_DAYS) return null;
        return parsed.v;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const setStorage = (key, value) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ v: value, t: Date.now() }));
      } catch {
        // localStorage unavailable (private mode, quota, etc.) — fail silently
      }
    };

    // --- Capture on every page load ---
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const gclid = params.get('gclid');
    const hasUtm = UTM_KEYS.some((key) => params.get(key));

    if (hasUtm) {
      UTM_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
        const val = params.get(key);
        if (!val) return;
        if (!getStorage(`ft_${key}`)) setStorage(`ft_${key}`, val); // first touch: set once
        setStorage(`lt_${key}`, val); // last touch: always overwrite
      });
    }

    if (gclid) {
      if (!getStorage('ft_gclid')) setStorage('ft_gclid', gclid);
      setStorage('lt_gclid', gclid);
    }

    // --- Backfill Marketo hidden fields ---
    const isEmpty = (val) => !val || String(val).toLowerCase() === 'none';

    const FIELD_MAP = [
      ['First_Touch_Source__c', 'ft_utm_source'],
      ['First_Touch_Medium__c', 'ft_utm_medium'],
      ['First_Touch_Campaign__c', 'ft_utm_campaign'],
      ['First_Touch_Content__c', 'ft_utm_content'],
      ['First_Touch_Term__c', 'ft_utm_term'],
      ['Last_Touch_Source__c', 'lt_utm_source'],
      ['Last_Touch_Medium__c', 'lt_utm_medium'],
      ['Last_Touch_Campaign__c', 'lt_utm_campaign'],
      ['Last_Touch_Content__c', 'lt_utm_content'],
      ['Last_Touch_Term__c', 'lt_utm_term'],
    ];

    const backfillForm = (form) => {
      const vals = form.vals();
      const updates = {};

      FIELD_MAP.forEach(([field, storeKey]) => {
        const stored = getStorage(storeKey);
        if (isEmpty(vals[field]) && stored) updates[field] = stored;
      });

      if (isEmpty(vals.GCLID__c)) {
        const gc = getStorage('lt_gclid') || getStorage('ft_gclid');
        if (gc) updates.GCLID__c = gc;
      }

      if (Object.keys(updates).length) form.vals(updates);
    };

    const attachToMarketo = () => {
      if (typeof MktoForms2 === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(attachToMarketo, 300);
        return;
      }

      MktoForms2.whenReady((form) => {
        backfillForm(form); // fix values as soon as the form renders
        form.onSubmit(() => backfillForm(form)); // re-check before submit, in case Bizible overwrote with "none" after whenReady
      });
    };

    attachToMarketo();
  })();
</script></body></html>

      let resetTimeout = null;

      const slider = new Swiper('.swiper.hm-hero', {
        slidesPerView: 1,
        speed: 600,
        loop: false,
        simulateTouch: false,
        effect: 'fade',
        fadeEffect: {
          crossFade: true,

        },

          prevEl: '.swiper-prev.hm-hero',
        },
        on: {
          init: function () {
            updateBullets(this.realIndex);
          },
          slideChange: function () {
            if (resetTimeout) {
              clearTimeout(resetTimeout);
              resetTimeout = null;
            }
            updateBullets(this.realIndex);
          },
          reachEnd: function () {
            if (resetTimeout) {
              clearTimeout(resetTimeout);
            }
            resetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
              this.slideTo(0);
              resetTimeout = null;
            }, 7000);
          },
        },
      });

      function updateBullets(index) {
        const allBullets = document.querySelectorAll('.c-hm-hero-progress-bullet');

        allBullets.forEach((bullet) => {
          bullet.classList.remove('is-active');
          const progressBar = bullet.querySelector('.c-hm-hero-progress-bullet-bar');
          if (progressBar) {
            progressBar.style.transition = 'none';
            progressBar.style.width = '0%';
          }
        });

        const activeBullets = document.querySelectorAll(`[data-slide-index="${index}"]`);

        activeBullets.forEach((activeBullet) => {
          activeBullet.classList.add('is-active');

          const activeBar = activeBullet.querySelector('.c-hm-hero-progress-bullet-bar');
          if (activeBar) {
            setTimeout(() => {
              activeBar.style.transition = 'width 7s linear';
              activeBar.style.width = '100%';
            }, 10);
          }
        });
      }

      bullets.forEach((bullet, index) => {
        bullet.setAttribute('data-slide-index', index % slider.slides.length);

        bullet.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (resetTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(resetTimeout);
            resetTimeout = null;
          }
          slider.slideTo(index % slider.slides.length);
          slider.autoplay.start();
        });
      });
      updateBullets(0);
    }
    homeHeroSlider();
  });

 window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const MS_PER_SLIDE = 10000;
  let currentTab = 0;
  let intervalId;

  const tabsWrap = document.querySelector('.process-tabs');
  const tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.process-tabs .process-tabs__menu__link');
  const tabPanes = document.querySelectorAll('.process-tabs .process-tabs__content__pane');
  const progressBarOverlay = document.querySelector('.process-tabs .process-tabs__progress__overlay');

  const setProgressBarForTab = (tabIndex) => {
    const totalTabs = tabLinks.length;
    const startPercentage = ((totalTabs - tabIndex) / totalTabs) * 100;
    progressBarOverlay.style.transition = 'none';
    progressBarOverlay.style.width = `${startPercentage}%`;
  };

  const animateProgressBar = (tabIndex) => {
    const totalTabs = tabLinks.length;
    const endPercentage = ((totalTabs - tabIndex - 1) / totalTabs) * 100;

    setTimeout(() => {
      progressBarOverlay.style.transition = `width ${MS_PER_SLIDE}ms linear`;
      progressBarOverlay.style.width = `${endPercentage}%`;
    }, 50);
  };

  tabLinks.forEach((tab, index) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      currentTab = index;

      const correspondingLottie = tabPanes[index].querySelector('.lottie-placeholder');
      //   console.log(`Tab clicked: ${index}`, correspondingLottie, correspondingLottie.lottieInstance);

      tab.classList.remove('w--current');
      setTimeout(() => {
        tab.classList.add('w--current');
        if (correspondingLottie && correspondingLottie.lottieInstance) {
          correspondingLottie.lottieInstance.goToAndPlay(0, true);
        }
        window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
      }, 10);
      setProgressBarForTab(currentTab);
      clearInterval(intervalId);
      clickTabsOneByOne();
    });
  });

  const handleIntersection = (entries, observer) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const intersectionRatio = entry.intersectionRatio;
        if (intersectionRatio >= 0.4) {
          tabLinks[currentTab].click();
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(handleIntersection, {
    threshold: 0.8,
  });
  observer.observe(tabsWrap);

  const clickTabsOneByOne = () => {
    animateProgressBar(currentTab);

    intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      const nextTab = currentTab + 1;
      if (nextTab < tabLinks.length) {
        tabLinks[nextTab].click();
      } else {
        tabLinks[0].click();
      }
    }, MS_PER_SLIDE);
  };

  // Initialize
  setProgressBarForTab(0);
});

</script></div><div fade="" data-current="Tab 1" data-easing="ease" data-duration-in="300" data-duration-out="100" class="process-tabs w-tabs"><div class="process-tabs__menu w-tab-menu"><a <script>
/* Move images inside accordion on mobile */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  let windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.c-section.duplex');

  if (sections.length === 0) {
    console.warn('No duplex sections found');
    return;
  }

  // Store state for each section
  const sectionStates = new Map();

  sections.forEach((section) => {
    const accordionWrap = section.querySelector('.o-row.duplex.ac');
    const accordionLinks = section.querySelectorAll('.o-row.duplex .c-duplex_lt-ac .c-ac-item');
    const accordionAssetsWrap = section.querySelector('.o-row.duplex .c-duplex_rt-ac');

    if (!accordionWrap || !accordionLinks.length || !accordionAssetsWrap) {
      console.warn('Required accordion elements not found in section', section);
      return;
    }

    // Initialize state for this section
    sectionStates.set(section, {
      isMobileMode: false,
      observer: null,
      accordionWrap,
      accordionLinks,
      accordionAssetsWrap,
    });
  });

  const moveAssetsIntoActiveItem = (state) => {
    const activeLink = Array.from(state.accordionLinks).find((link) =>
      link.classList.contains('is-active')
    );
    if (activeLink && !activeLink.contains(state.accordionAssetsWrap)) {
      activeLink.appendChild(state.accordionAssetsWrap);
    }
  };

  const moveAssetsBackToOriginal = (state) => {
    if (state.accordionAssetsWrap.parentElement !== state.accordionWrap) {
      state.accordionWrap.appendChild(state.accordionAssetsWrap);
    }
  };

  const setupMobileMode = (state) => {
    if (state.isMobileMode) return;

    state.observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      moveAssetsIntoActiveItem(state);
    });

    state.accordionLinks.forEach((link) => {
      state.observer.observe(link, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    });

    moveAssetsIntoActiveItem(state);
    state.isMobileMode = true;
  };

  const setupDesktopMode = (state) => {
    if (!state.isMobileMode) return;

    if (state.observer) {
      state.observer.disconnect();
      state.observer = null;
    }

    moveAssetsBackToOriginal(state);
    state.isMobileMode = false;
  };

  const handleResponsiveLayout = () => {
    const shouldBeMobile = windowWidth < 992;

    sectionStates.forEach((state) => {
      if (shouldBeMobile) {
        setupMobileMode(state);
      } else {
        setupDesktopMode(state);
      }
    });
  };

  handleResponsiveLayout();

  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
      handleResponsiveLayout();
    }, 100);
  });
});

<script>
  (() => {
    const UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    const STORAGE_DAYS = 90;

    const getStorage = (key) => {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if ((Date.now() - parsed.t) / 86400000 > STORAGE_DAYS) return null;
        return parsed.v;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const setStorage = (key, value) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ v: value, t: Date.now() }));
      } catch {
        // localStorage unavailable (private mode, quota, etc.) — fail silently
      }
    };

    // --- Capture on every page load ---
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const gclid = params.get('gclid');
    const hasUtm = UTM_KEYS.some((key) => params.get(key));

    if (hasUtm) {
      UTM_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
        const val = params.get(key);
        if (!val) return;
        if (!getStorage(`ft_${key}`)) setStorage(`ft_${key}`, val); // first touch: set once
        setStorage(`lt_${key}`, val); // last touch: always overwrite
      });
    }

    if (gclid) {
      if (!getStorage('ft_gclid')) setStorage('ft_gclid', gclid);
      setStorage('lt_gclid', gclid);
    }

    // --- Backfill Marketo hidden fields ---
    const isEmpty = (val) => !val || String(val).toLowerCase() === 'none';

    const FIELD_MAP = [
      ['First_Touch_Source__c', 'ft_utm_source'],
      ['First_Touch_Medium__c', 'ft_utm_medium'],
      ['First_Touch_Campaign__c', 'ft_utm_campaign'],
      ['First_Touch_Content__c', 'ft_utm_content'],
      ['First_Touch_Term__c', 'ft_utm_term'],
      ['Last_Touch_Source__c', 'lt_utm_source'],
      ['Last_Touch_Medium__c', 'lt_utm_medium'],
      ['Last_Touch_Campaign__c', 'lt_utm_campaign'],
      ['Last_Touch_Content__c', 'lt_utm_content'],
      ['Last_Touch_Term__c', 'lt_utm_term'],
    ];

    const backfillForm = (form) => {
      const vals = form.vals();
      const updates = {};

      FIELD_MAP.forEach(([field, storeKey]) => {
        const stored = getStorage(storeKey);
        if (isEmpty(vals[field]) && stored) updates[field] = stored;
      });

      if (isEmpty(vals.GCLID__c)) {
        const gc = getStorage('lt_gclid') || getStorage('ft_gclid');
        if (gc) updates.GCLID__c = gc;
      }

      if (Object.keys(updates).length) form.vals(updates);
    };

    const attachToMarketo = () => {
      if (typeof MktoForms2 === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(attachToMarketo, 300);
        return;
      }

      MktoForms2.whenReady((form) => {
        backfillForm(form); // fix values as soon as the form renders
        form.onSubmit(() => backfillForm(form)); // re-check before submit, in case Bizible overwrote with "none" after whenReady
      });
    };

    attachToMarketo();
  })();
</script></body></html>

<script>
  (() => {
    const UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    const STORAGE_DAYS = 90;

    const getStorage = (key) => {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if ((Date.now() - parsed.t) / 86400000 > STORAGE_DAYS) return null;
        return parsed.v;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const setStorage = (key, value) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ v: value, t: Date.now() }));
      } catch {
        // localStorage unavailable (private mode, quota, etc.) — fail silently
      }
    };

    // --- Capture on every page load ---
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const gclid = params.get('gclid');
    const hasUtm = UTM_KEYS.some((key) => params.get(key));

    if (hasUtm) {
      UTM_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
        const val = params.get(key);
        if (!val) return;
        if (!getStorage(`ft_${key}`)) setStorage(`ft_${key}`, val); // first touch: set once
        setStorage(`lt_${key}`, val); // last touch: always overwrite
      });
    }

    if (gclid) {
      if (!getStorage('ft_gclid')) setStorage('ft_gclid', gclid);
      setStorage('lt_gclid', gclid);
    }

    // --- Backfill Marketo hidden fields ---
    const isEmpty = (val) => !val || String(val).toLowerCase() === 'none';

    const FIELD_MAP = [
      ['First_Touch_Source__c', 'ft_utm_source'],
      ['First_Touch_Medium__c', 'ft_utm_medium'],
      ['First_Touch_Campaign__c', 'ft_utm_campaign'],
      ['First_Touch_Content__c', 'ft_utm_content'],
      ['First_Touch_Term__c', 'ft_utm_term'],
      ['Last_Touch_Source__c', 'lt_utm_source'],
      ['Last_Touch_Medium__c', 'lt_utm_medium'],
      ['Last_Touch_Campaign__c', 'lt_utm_campaign'],
      ['Last_Touch_Content__c', 'lt_utm_content'],
      ['Last_Touch_Term__c', 'lt_utm_term'],
    ];

    const backfillForm = (form) => {
      const vals = form.vals();
      const updates = {};

      FIELD_MAP.forEach(([field, storeKey]) => {
        const stored = getStorage(storeKey);
        if (isEmpty(vals[field]) && stored) updates[field] = stored;
      });

      if (isEmpty(vals.GCLID__c)) {
        const gc = getStorage('lt_gclid') || getStorage('ft_gclid');
        if (gc) updates.GCLID__c = gc;
      }

      if (Object.keys(updates).length) form.vals(updates);
    };

    const attachToMarketo = () => {
      if (typeof MktoForms2 === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(attachToMarketo, 300);
        return;
      }

      MktoForms2.whenReady((form) => {
        backfillForm(form); // fix values as soon as the form renders
        form.onSubmit(() => backfillForm(form)); // re-check before submit, in case Bizible overwrote with "none" after whenReady
      });
    };

    attachToMarketo();
  })();
</script></body></html>

  100% {

<script>
  (() => {
    const UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    const STORAGE_DAYS = 90;

    const getStorage = (key) => {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if ((Date.now() - parsed.t) / 86400000 > STORAGE_DAYS) return null;
        return parsed.v;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const setStorage = (key, value) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ v: value, t: Date.now() }));
      } catch {
        // localStorage unavailable (private mode, quota, etc.) — fail silently
      }
    };

    // --- Capture on every page load ---
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const gclid = params.get('gclid');
    const hasUtm = UTM_KEYS.some((key) => params.get(key));

    if (hasUtm) {
      UTM_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
        const val = params.get(key);
        if (!val) return;
        if (!getStorage(`ft_${key}`)) setStorage(`ft_${key}`, val); // first touch: set once
        setStorage(`lt_${key}`, val); // last touch: always overwrite
      });
    }

    if (gclid) {
      if (!getStorage('ft_gclid')) setStorage('ft_gclid', gclid);
      setStorage('lt_gclid', gclid);
    }

    // --- Backfill Marketo hidden fields ---
    const isEmpty = (val) => !val || String(val).toLowerCase() === 'none';

    const FIELD_MAP = [
      ['First_Touch_Source__c', 'ft_utm_source'],
      ['First_Touch_Medium__c', 'ft_utm_medium'],
      ['First_Touch_Campaign__c', 'ft_utm_campaign'],
      ['First_Touch_Content__c', 'ft_utm_content'],
      ['First_Touch_Term__c', 'ft_utm_term'],
      ['Last_Touch_Source__c', 'lt_utm_source'],
      ['Last_Touch_Medium__c', 'lt_utm_medium'],
      ['Last_Touch_Campaign__c', 'lt_utm_campaign'],
      ['Last_Touch_Content__c', 'lt_utm_content'],
      ['Last_Touch_Term__c', 'lt_utm_term'],
    ];

    const backfillForm = (form) => {
      const vals = form.vals();
      const updates = {};

      FIELD_MAP.forEach(([field, storeKey]) => {
        const stored = getStorage(storeKey);
        if (isEmpty(vals[field]) && stored) updates[field] = stored;
      });

      if (isEmpty(vals.GCLID__c)) {
        const gc = getStorage('lt_gclid') || getStorage('ft_gclid');
        if (gc) updates.GCLID__c = gc;
      }

      if (Object.keys(updates).length) form.vals(updates);
    };

    const attachToMarketo = () => {
      if (typeof MktoForms2 === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(attachToMarketo, 300);
        return;
      }

      MktoForms2.whenReady((form) => {
        backfillForm(form); // fix values as soon as the form renders
        form.onSubmit(() => backfillForm(form)); // re-check before submit, in case Bizible overwrote with "none" after whenReady
      });
    };

    attachToMarketo();
  })();
</script></body></html>
